title: C&I Billing Correction Lookback, Care Desk Limit and Charge Rounding
content:
Three billing figures are common to all six Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts structures: how long after posting a bill line may still be corrected, the largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line, and the rounding of every computed charge.

| Structure | Correction lookback after posting | Largest rebill credit a care agent may post on one line | Rounding of every computed charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | 24 calendar months | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | 24 calendar months | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | 24 calendar months | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | 24 calendar months | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | 24 calendar months | $500.00 | half up to the cent |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | 24 calendar months | $500.00 | half up to the cent |

## Rounding illustrated (hypothetical amounts)

| Unrounded amount | Rounded half up to the cent |
|---|---|
| 1284.5650 | 1284.57 |
| 1284.5649 | 1284.56 |
| 72.005 | 72.01 |

A third decimal of exactly 5 rounds the cent up.
